description: This Java class 'Combinations' provides utilities to generate combinations of a set of size n taken k at a time. It includes iterators for lexicographic order, methods to get the size of the set and subset, and comparator for ordering combinations.

classes.name: Combinations
classes.description: A utility class for generating and iterating over combinations of a set of size n, taken k at a time, with support for lexicographic ordering and comparison.

classes.name: Combinations.IterationOrder
classes.description: Enum describing iteration order; currently only lexicographic order is supported.

classes.name: Combinations.LexicographicIterator
classes.description: Iterator that generates combinations in lexicographic order based on algorithm T from Knuth, 2004.

classes.name: Combinations.SingletonIterator
classes.description: Iterator that returns a single pre-defined array, used for degenerate cases k=0 or k=n.

classes.name: Combinations.LexicographicComparator
classes.description: Comparator for comparing two combinations lexicographically, using lexNorm to convert arrays into comparable long values.

methods.name: Combinations.getN
methods.description: Returns the size of the source set from which combinations are drawn.

methods.name: Combinations.getK
methods.description: Returns the size of each combination.

methods.name: Combinations.iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over combinations, in lexicographic order by default.

methods.name: Combinations.comparator
methods.description: Returns a comparator for combinations that compares between two combination arrays.
